user.description: Choose a room temperature sensor and the ESPHome device. Set the regulation mode on the ESPHome device. Turning the stove Off or changing its native target manually switches the mode to Local. To resume compensation, press “Reactivate room compensation” on the ESPHome device. This button does not turn the stove on.

error.unsupported_firmware: This ESPHome device does not expose the Duepi Room Relay v1 text entity.
error.ambiguous_relay: More than one Duepi Room Relay v1 text entity was found.
error.unsupported_unit: Select a sensor that reports temperature in Celsius or Fahrenheit.

abort.already_configured: This ESPHome device is already configured.
